app.title: O&O ShutUp10 – The antispy tool for Windows 10 and 11
app.author: embedding-shape
app.description: A Windows utility that disables telemetry, privacy‑related features, and other background services to reduce spyware and data leakage.
proposed_tests: Download the installer and run a silent install to verify no prompts.
Execute the command‑line with /? flag and check for help output.
Run the tool against a sandboxed Windows VM with a known spyware sample, then confirm removal of malicious processes and registry keys.
Verify that telemetry services (e.g., WMI, Telemetry) are disabled after execution.
